name: Osu Shopping District

en.name: Osu Shopping District
en.description: Lively shopping quarter around Osu Kannon in Nagoya, where covered arcades are known for electronics, secondhand and vintage shops, character goods and quirky cafes. A favorite for bargain hunting, street food and a glimpse of the city's pop culture.
en.notes: Osu Shopping District is Nagoya's largest shopping quarter around Osu Kannon, with covered arcades known for electronics, secondhand shops, character goods, and the Osu festival. This record is verified current; no duplicate card is added.

ja.name: 大須商店街
ja.description: 大須観音周辺に広がる商店街エリア。アーケード街には家電・中古品店、キャラクターグッズ店や個性派カフェが並び、掘り出し物探しやグルメが楽しめる。
ja.notes: 大須商店街は大須観音周辺に広がる名古屋最大の商店街です。アーケードには家電、リサイクルショップ、キャラクターグッズ店などが並び、大須まつりも開催されます。このレコードは現状確認済みで、重複カードは追加しません。
